Although you haven't mentioned it, I know that you seek to save the Mother Tree... This book should be of great help to you... Your faith in the Goddess of harmony and light will guide your path. Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-01.h.text: Priest Adonius: Were you sent by the guards? Oh, thank heaven you've arrived! We are desperately in need of your help! First, I suppose I should tell you of the horrible event of three days ago. Priestess Agnes was leading a group of the faithful of our congregation back home from a pilgrimage to t…

Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-04.h.text: Priest Adonius: You have performed a noble deed for our temple. Now Agnes can have a funeral befitting a person of her stature. It is all so very tragic! I know that all that happens is the will of Einhasad, still, when something so senseless happens it makes a person wonder... Well, we must medita…

Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-03.h.text: Priest Adonius: Please recover the crucifix and rosary that belonged to Priestess Agnes. This is essential if we are to give her a proper funeral. You will find her remains on the south shore of Gludio. You should leave for there immediately! May the light of Einhasad guide your path...

Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-05.h.text: Priest Adonius: High Priestess Levian is expecting you. She will tell you what you need to do.

Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-06.h.text: Priest Adonius: Oh Divine One, please give this fine warrior the strength and courage to conquer the evil ones...

Q00413_PathOfTheShillienOracle/30375-01..text: Priest Adonius: This place is the holy hall where we serve Einhasad, god of light. Why have you, a member of the race of darkness, set foot in this place?

links.text: Say you have decided to walk the path of light

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30375-02.html.text: Priest Adonius: Thank you so much, brother of the forest. We have run short of the ink and pens which are used for copying the sacred texts. To make the ink, we need Spider Ichor . You can extract it from the spiders of the Cruma Marshlands . As for the pens, we create them with Harpy's Down . It w…

Q00340_SubjugationOfLizardmen/30375-02.h.text: Priest Adonius: Oh, thank you! The site of the massacre is on the south shore of Gludio. Please find and return the remains of Priestess Agnes so that we can give her a proper burial. Please, bring us her crucifix and rosary . Now please be off, time is of the essence...

Q00413_PathOfTheShillienOracle/30375-02..text: Priest Adonius: There have been Dark Elves that have said the same thing before. We priests showed them compassion and taught them the path of light, but we found out that they were false seekers of truth with their eye on the power of white magic. I can no longer trust the words of your kind.

links.text: Show him the Prayer of Adonius

Q00413_PathOfTheShillienOracle/30375-03..text: Priest Adonius: Why this is the prayer book that I wrote ... You have this too? This was published in the form of a book of poems with prayers I made to Einhasad when I was young. It became known among the younger generation through rumors, and now it is a book beloved by many people. It is embarra…

Q00413_PathOfTheShillienOracle/30375-04..text: Priest Adonius: Unlike your gods, who hide truth within darkness, Einhasad is a benevolent god. We priests have been permitted a portion of the songs of light, written in Andariel's Book. If you have decided to repent your wicked past and follow the creed of the light, I will give you a copy of the…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30375-note.text: Priest Adonius: Following the will of Eva, I only teach Elves who wish to walk the path of magic. I have nothing to teach to others.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30375.html.text: Prefect Adonius: Be welcome to this temple! This sacred place is always open to those who serve Einhasad. When you seek peace and comfort, do not forget it. How may I help you today?

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/learn-lowl.text: In order to use the Skill Transfer system, you must be level 76 or higher and have completed your 3rd class transfer.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
